[A great loss](http://www.afr.com/p/national/peter_ruehl_columnist_and_humorist_TkZcKOK7g0E4NRGEl3y0ZL). Possibly the only reason many people read the AFR. A favourite Ruehl line (from the early 1990s):

> *Telecom is communism without the tanks.*

Thanks for all the laughs Pete.
